description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations & Sabaragamuwa Development - Industrial Disputes - K. Kaluarachchi with others vs. Sri Lanka Ports Authority and K. W. R. Sisira vs. Lanka Electricity Company (Pvt.) Ltd. (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and amendments, making it a statutory instrument for dispute resolution procedures. While it mentions a Minister's name and title, this is incidental to the legal function being performed rather than constituting a government personnel appointment or portfolio assignment.
